record.paper_title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds
record.original_question: Under what conditions does every deformation of the total space of a vector bundle again carry the structure of an affine bundle?

evidence.quote: Question 17. Under what conditions do all deformations of the total space of a vector bundle have the structure of affine bundles?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E \to B$ be a holomorphic vector bundle over a complex manifold $B$, and let $X$ denote the total space of $E$, which is itself a complex manifold. Recall that an affine bundle over $B$ is a holomorphic fiber bundle whose fibers are affine spaces and whose transition functions act by affine transformations (i.e., a torsor over a vector bundle); equivalently, it is a holomorphic submersion locally isomorphic to a vector bundle, with structure group reduced to the affine group of the typical fiber. By a deformation of $X$ we mean a proper flat family $\mathcal{X} \to \Delta$ over a disk $\Delta \subset \mathbb{C}$ (or, more generally, a flat family of complex manifolds with central fiber $X$, possibly in the compactifiable sense where $X$ admits a smooth compactification to which the deformation extends), together with an identification of the central fiber with $X$.

Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on the base $B$ and on the vector bundle $E \to B$ under which every (sufficiently small) deformation of the complex manifold $X = \mathrm{tot}(E)$ again admits the structure of an affine bundle over a (possibly deformed) base, with typical fiber an affine space modeled on the fibers of $E$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as one of twenty open problems on deformations of compactifiable manifolds. Searches reveal partial results in special cases (e.g., deformations of certain noncompact surfaces realized as affine bundles over $\mathbb{P}^1$ via compactifications to Hirzebruch surfaces), but no general necessary-and-sufficient criterion appears in the literature. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Classical deformations of noncompact surfaces and their compactifications
status_evidence.snippet: Considers deformations as an affine bundle over P^1; affineness of deformations is proved via compactifications to Hirzebruch surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Special cases admit affine-bundle deformations, but no general criterion is established.

status_evidence.title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds (arXiv:2004.11299)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open questions on deformations of compactifiable manifolds, including conditions for deformations of vector-bundle total spaces to be affine bundles.
status_evidence.claim: The question is presented as open.
